luminary.command.not_ready: Luminary is not ready yet (server state not loaded)
luminary.command.status: Luminary: %s discovery templates, %s catalog records, %s executed effects
luminary.catalog.unknown_template: No discovery template with that id (check data/<ns>/luminary/discoveries/)
luminary.catalog.not_observed: That discovery has not been observed yet
luminary.catalog.not_verified: That discovery is not verified yet
luminary.catalog.already_applied: That discovery is already in practical use
luminary.catalog.dependency_unverified: A prerequisite discovery is not verified yet
luminary.catalog.need_samples: Not enough samples handed in yet
luminary.catalog.need_experiment: A required experiment has not been recorded yet
luminary.command.progression_status: Era: %s. Unlocked %s of %s technologies. Capabilities: [%s]. Signals: %s
luminary.progression.unknown_technology: No technology with that id (check data/<ns>/luminary/technologies/)
luminary.progression.prerequisites_unmet: Prerequisites are not met (see /luminary progression technologies)
luminary.command.story_status: Story phase: %s. Branch: %s. Clues revealed: %s of %s (%s revealable now)
luminary.story.unknown_phase: No story phase with that id
luminary.story.same_phase: The story is already in that phase
luminary.story.unknown_branch: No story branch with that id
luminary.story.clue_locked: That clue is locked: its phase has not been reached or its conditions do not hold (no override exists)
story.clue.luminary.ore_hum: The mineral hums when nobody is listening. Count the pauses; they are not random.
story.clue.luminary.compass_lie: Your compass does not lie. It answers a different question.
story.clue.luminary.record_author: Whoever wrote the record counted the same pauses. Then they stopped counting.
luminary.command.npc_provider_set: Dialogue provider set to %s (until restart; config/luminary.json holds the default)
luminary.command.npc_unknown_provider: Unknown dialogue provider '%s' (known: scripted, disabled, model)
luminary.command.needs_player: This command needs a player executor
luminary.npc.unknown: No NPC definition with that id (check data/<ns>/luminary/npcs/)
luminary.npc.already_present: That NPC already has a body in a loaded world
luminary.npc.not_present: That NPC has no body in any loaded world
luminary.npc.spawn_failed: The NPC could not be spawned here
dialogue.luminary.ai.greeting_1: Oh! A face. Faces are rarer than they used to be. Welcome, welcome.
dialogue.luminary.ai.greeting_2: Don't mind the humming. It isn't me. Mostly.
dialogue.luminary.ai.ore_verified: So the Luminarium wrote it down. The stone, I mean. Good. Paper remembers better than I do.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_investigatio: Investigate, they said. Yes. Measure it twice before it measures you.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_containment: Walls. Fine. Walls are honest. Just remember who is on which side.
dialogue.luminary.ai.branch_exploitation: Dig it up and sell it, then. I only ask that you count what comes back out.
luminary.command.container_allowed: NPC %s may now deposit into the container at %s
luminary.command.container_denied: NPC %s may no longer deposit into the container at %s
luminary.command.task_cancelled: Task of %s cancelled (carried items stay with the NPC)
luminary.task.bad_arguments: Invalid task arguments (count out of range or target equals container)
luminary.task.out_of_range: Target or container is out of the NPC's range
luminary.task.not_loaded: Target or container is not in a loaded chunk
luminary.task.target_not_log: The target block is not a log
luminary.task.container_not_inventory: The container block has no inventory
luminary.task.container_unauthorized: The NPC is not authorized to deposit into that container (/luminary npc container allow)
luminary.task.container_full: The container has no free slot
luminary.task.not_permitted: The NPC may not act in this context
luminary.task.already_active: The NPC already has an active task
luminary.task.none_active: The NPC has no active task
luminary.command.llm_ping_sent: Ping sent to provider %s; the answer arrives when the model replies
luminary.command.memory_noted: Note added to the memory of %s
